tr.title: make ve do farkı nedir?
tr.metaDesc: make vs do farkı: make ne demek, ne zaman make ne zaman do kullanılır? Örneklerle açıklama — LinguaBattle.
tr.lede: make ve do İngilizce öğrenenlerin en çok karıştırdığı iki fiildir. Kısa kural: make = bir şey üretmek/yaratmak, do = bir eylem/görev yapmak. Düzensiz: make → made → made.

means.def: make = üretmek, yaratmak (ortaya bir şey çıkar)

means.en: make a decision, make a mistake, make money
means.t: karar vermek, hata yapmak, para kazanmak

en.title: Make vs do: what's the difference?
en.metaDesc: Make vs do difference: what does make mean, when to use make vs do? Explained with examples — LinguaBattle.
en.lede: make and do are the two most confused English verbs. Quick rule: make = produce/create something, do = perform an action/task. Irregular: make → made → made.

means.en: make a decision, make a mistake, make money

de.title: Make vs do: Was ist der Unterschied?
de.metaDesc: Unterschied make vs do: Was bedeutet make, wann make und wann do? Mit Beispielen erklärt — LinguaBattle.
de.lede: make und do sind die zwei am häufigsten verwechselten englischen Verben. Faustregel: make = etwas herstellen/erschaffen, do = eine Handlung/Aufgabe ausführen. Unregelmäßig: make → made → made.

means.en: make a decision, make a mistake, make money

fr.title: Make vs do : quelle différence ?
fr.metaDesc: Différence make vs do : que signifie make, quand utiliser make ou do ? Expliqué avec des exemples — LinguaBattle.
fr.lede: make et do sont les deux verbes anglais les plus confondus. Règle simple : make = produire/créer quelque chose, do = effectuer une action/tâche. Irrégulier : make → made → made.

means.def: make = produire, créer (quelque chose en résulte)

means.en: make a decision, make a mistake, make money

es.title: Make vs do: ¿cuál es la diferencia?
es.metaDesc: Diferencia make vs do: qué significa make, ¿cuándo usar make o do? Explicado con ejemplos — LinguaBattle.
es.lede: make y do son los dos verbos ingleses más confundidos. Regla rápida: make = producir/crear algo, do = realizar una acción/tarea. Irregular: make → made → made.

means.en: make a decision, make a mistake, make money

ar.title: ما الفرق بين make و do؟
ar.metaDesc: الفرق بين make وdo: ماذا تعني make، ومتى نستخدم make أو do؟ شرح بالأمثلة — LinguaBattle.
ar.lede: make وdo من أكثر الأفعال الإنجليزية التي يُخلط بينها. القاعدة المبسطة: make = تصنع/تنتج شيئًا، do = تؤدّي فعلًا/مهمة. شاذ: make → made → made.

means.en: make a decision, make a mistake, make money

hi.title: make और do में क्या अंतर है?
hi.metaDesc: make बनाम do का अंतर: make का मतलब, कब make और कब do? उदाहरणों सहित समझाया — LinguaBattle.
hi.lede: make और do सबसे ज़्यादा भ्रमित करने वाली दो अंग्रेज़ी क्रियाएँ हैं। आसान नियम: make = कुछ बनाना/उत्पन्न करना, do = कोई काम/क्रिया करना। अनियमित: make → made → made.

means.def: make = बनाना, उत्पन्न करना (कुछ बनता है)

means.en: make a decision, make a mistake, make money

hi.quizQ: कौन सा सही है? “___ a mistake”

ru.title: Make и do: в чём разница?
ru.metaDesc: Разница make и do: что значит make, когда make, а когда do? С примерами — LinguaBattle.
ru.lede: make и do — два самых путаемых английских глагола. Простое правило: make = создавать/производить что-то, do = выполнять действие/задачу. Неправильный: make → made → made.

means.en: make a decision, make a mistake, make money

pt.title: Make vs do: qual é a diferença?
pt.metaDesc: Diferença make vs do: o que significa make, quando usar make ou do? Explicado com exemplos — LinguaBattle.
pt.lede: make e do são os dois verbos ingleses mais confundidos. Regra rápida: make = produzir/criar algo, do = realizar uma ação/tarefa. Irregular: make → made → made.

means.en: make a decision, make a mistake, make money

ja.title: makeとdoの違いは？
ja.metaDesc: makeとdoの違い：makeの意味、makeとdoの使い分けは？例文で解説 — LinguaBattle.
ja.lede: make と do は最も混同されやすい2つの英語動詞。簡単なルール：make = 何かを作り出す、do = 行動・作業をする。不規則：make → made → made。

means.def: make = 作る、生み出す（何かができる）
do = 作業・行動をする

means.en: make a decision, make a mistake, make money
